verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's release notes document draft PR creation: you can ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view. That is a manual, on-demand trigger rather than an agent configured to open a PR automatically when its task completes. The non-interactive `humanlayer automation run` path for CI and scripts exists, but nothing ties it to PR creation. Missing for 10: a configurable auto-open-PR-on-completion setting, documentation of non-draft PRs, evidence that the automation sessions open PRs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
